name: Pierre Veyron
features: fair skin, dark hair neatly parted, dark eyes, oval face, neat features, slight compact build, modest reticent expression
bio: A Bugatti man almost from the start, with his first win at the 1930 Geneva Grand Prix in a Type 37A and Avus victories in 1933 and 1934. His name belongs to the 1939 Le Mans, which he won with Jean-Pierre Wimille in the Type 57S Tank. He was decorated with the Legion of Honour in 1945 for his Resistance work, and sixty years later Bugatti put his name on its fastest road car.
